chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi, a janitor at the W.N Research Institute, successfully ingratiates himself with Professor Ritter of Group A by demonstrating knowledge of 'Spatial Energetics'. Ritter, impressed by Shen's potential, arranges for him to audit classes at Blue Star High School to build his academic foundation. Shen discovers that the school is the same one attended by Gu Suizhou, who is currently being taught by Director Jiang Che. The chapter concludes with Shen Feizhi arriving at Blue Star High School as an auditing student, immediately asserting dominance by slapping Gu Suizhou on the head while he is sleeping in class.
